Our review already splits this cleanly: base WIN-058 covers the angular-coordinate claim (matches model.html), and WIN-058b covers the Bedrock Induction Ratio claim (matches wins.html) -- both correctly mapped, no drift, no action needed. This matches every prior day's finding (not new). First caught 2026-07-10, tracked as ISS-2961 (open, status=assigned-analyst), still present today unchanged -- downgraded to informational here per the tracked-finding convention, no action needed on our WIN-062 verdict (claim='Tesla longitudinal wave 1.574c', already covers this regardless of which dome write-up it maps to). WIN-070 ('Forensic Zoom' chart, detail_group='WIN-011/012') remains a sub-claim grouped under WIN-011/012 rather than a standalone dome wins.html entry, consistent with every prior day -- not a gap. No title/claim drift found on a full-catalog keyword-overlap pass across all 69 WIN-NNN dome titles vs our claim fields (1 initial low-overlap flag on WIN-058 was explained by the known 058/058b split above, not genuine drift).
